cues.text: You are at work in Wilduck Burger. Ryoji walks up to you with his school bag.
Kenji, in the same staff uniform as you, walks over and stops short at the sight of Ryoji.
The three of you sit down together in a booth, at a table spread with trays of burgers, fries and drinks. Kenji sits with his arms crossed.
Kenji hurries off back to work, leaving you and Ryoji at the table with the food.
